Not imported: examples/stub-dev-team.yaml (only stub providers and credentials once stripped), examples/ticketing.yaml (connectors need the installer's credentials: needs credential params first).

items.title: Diagram designer
items.description: Draws flows on a diagram from a sentence, as operations Blobly applies: the designer Blobly asks when a request is more than he can read word for word.

diagram-designer.why: plans a whole flow from a loose sentence

items.title: Page builder
items.description: Builds A2UI pages from a description in the page builder, with the site it works on.

page-builder.why: composes whole pages and their data model

items.title: Blobly composer
items.description: Composes Blobly programs (workflows Blobly runs) from what a person asks, with an example program.

blobly-composer.why: writes a short workflow from a request

items.title: Librarian
items.description: Finds and files the organization's documents and answers from them.

items.title: Orchestrator and builder
items.description: An orchestrator that creates and changes anything in the organization with apply_manifest and asks other agents, and a builder that develops ragentic in a git worktree.

orchestrator.why: plans across apps, workflows and agents

builder.why: changes and tests code over many steps

items.title: Goal supervisor
items.description: Watches durable goals and says why a stuck one is stuck, who acts and what comes next.

supervisor.why: reads goal state and decides the next step

items.title: Vision reader
items.description: Reads pictures (labels, gauges, documents) with a vision model, from a workflow and a page to upload to.

reader.why: reads what is in a picture

items.title: Raspberry Pi GPIO workflows
items.description: Workflows that drive the pins of a Raspberry Pi: blink an LED on GPIO17, watch a button on GPIO27 and show presses on the web. Replace __DEVICE__ with the device's name when installing.

device.description: the device whose GPIO tools the workflows call (its name)

items.title: Porch station
items.description: A porch kiosk site: lamp, rain and events components on one page.

items.title: Social media team
items.description: A social media team: a lead, a writer, a community manager, an analyst and a screener, with their workflows for content, publishing, engagement and metrics.

items.title: Research desk
items.description: A research agent with its workspace, as one package.

items.title: Dev team
items.description: A software team: triage, architect, developer, reviewer, QA, release manager and scrum master, with their workflows.

items.title: Mock PLC tank
items.description: A simulated PLC driving a tank, with its connectors, tag streams, workflows and pages: a PLC to try ragentic's industrial tools on without hardware.

items.title: Paper intake
items.description: Streams and workflows that take in research papers, enrich them and report on them.
